title: EU, Indonesia officially sign 'ambitious' trade deal
paragraphs: EU, Indonesia officially sign 'ambitious' trade deal
Brussels said the deal will boost economic growth, with the EU's GDP projected to be 16 billion euros higher and Indonesia's 27 billion euros higher by 2042 than they would be without the agreement.
BRUSSELS: The EU and Indonesia officially signed a trade deal to open up their markets in Brussels on Saturday (Nov 21), paving the way for the accord to come into force early next year.
